scope: Property identity, current address and coordinate QA for Colorado's two tribal casino resorts before statewide runtime serialization.

records.name: Sky Ute Casino Resort
records.note: Current first-party materials preserve the 14324 US Highway 172 North public address. Independent current/local tourism and geocoded casino evidence converge on the casino property around 37.138,-107.632. Do not substitute RV-park-only coordinates farther north/east.

records.name: Ute Mountain Casino Hotel
records.note: Use the casino geometry, not the adjacent hotel-only geometry, RV park, travel center or parking coordinate. Current first-party contact material confirms 3 Weeminuche Drive.

importantDecisions: Sky Ute and Ute Mountain are distinct tribal casino destinations outside Colorado's 33 commercial regulator rows.
For Ute Mountain, casino-specific OSM way 185014426 controls over nearby hotel/RV/travel-center features.
For Sky Ute, preserve the current first-party 14324 US Highway 172 North address and use the casino-property coordinate rather than RV-park-only coordinates.
nextPhase: Continue commercial Colorado address/coordinate/stable-ID QA. The tribal portion no longer blocks Colorado runtime serialization.
